types.label: AgencyBloc internal consistency (Individual ↔ Policy)
types.description: Find clients in the Individual report missing from the Policy report and vice versa, and surface mismatches in agent, plan, status, or effective date.

types.label: AgencyBloc ↔ United Healthcare Book of Business
types.description: Compare AgencyBloc Individual data against UHC's Book of Business. Surfaces policies missing from either side and field mismatches.

types.label: AgencyBloc ↔ Humana Book of Business
types.description: Compare AgencyBloc Individual data against Humana's Book of Business. Humana's per-policy event history is collapsed to the latest event per policy before comparison.
